query: Which language has the third largest population by total number of speakers?

results.title: The world's most spoken languages... - WM Defense & Stats
results.content: English remains the world's most widely spoken language with 1.49 billion total speakers. Its dominance is driven by its role as the international language of business, science, aviation, technology, and entertainment. Mandarin Chinese follows with 1.18 billion speakers, supported by China's vast population and growing global economic influence. Hindi ranks third with 611 million speakers, reflecting India's rapidly expanding population and increasing global presence.
